issues.on_page: Electric Department total operating revenues 94,097,433, total operating expenses 94,333,393, net position 170,042,788
issues.issue: This is the City of Grand Island's Electric Fund. The same figures appear as the Electric Fund column of Grand_Island_FY2025 (its p8: operating revenues 94,097,433, operating expenses 94,333,393), and they are counted again in that report's enterprise Total. Adding both reports together double counts the utility. A person should decide whether to keep this report as a separate entity or mark it as included in the city. No decision_needed entry exists.
An unexplained 'Other revenue' line was put in charges for services/fees instead of other. It is an operating revenue, so this is defensible, and the line is already marked review.

issues.on_page: Accrual for in lieu of taxes 363,231
issues.issue: Payments in lieu of taxes are owed to the City (and other taxing bodies), so 'due to other governments' could fit better.

issues.on_page: Statements of Net Position - Electric Department (a single proprietary fund, 2025 column)
issues.issue: This is a stand-alone enterprise fund statement, not a government-wide statement. None of the allowed scope values fits exactly.
